content:
Last week delivered a collection of particularly notable price drops on current-generation Apple gear, from AirPods Pro 3 at 25% off to the latest AirPods Max 2 at $120 off the list price, but we are not done yet. While those deals are indeed still live, Amazon has just delivered the lowest price ever on Apple’s 2026 AirTag 2 – you can now land them as low as $20 a pop.

We featured a couple of all-time low deal prices on the next-generation AirTag 2 last week as part of the particularly notable anniversary sales, but if you missed out, worry not – the price just dropped even lower to deliver the best deal we have ever tracked.

Amazon is still offering the single AirTag 2 listing down at $24 – this is on par with the best price we have seen since release for one of them, but the 4-pack has now dropped down to $79.99 shipped.

Carrying a $99 list price, Apple’s official 4-pack already delivers a better per-Tag price than the regularly $29 single, but at just shy of 20% off the list price you’re looking at a new all-time low and just $20 per AirTag 2 here.

While it was pretty safe to assume the previous $90 deal price on the 4-pack was likely to remain live throughout the week alongside the big anniversary sales at major retailers, that’s not really the case with this new Amazon all-time low – there’s no telling when the price might jump back up on us.

We have already featured the differences between the previous-generation AirTag and this year’s AirTag 2 update – you can scope that out right here – but we will drop the highlights for you below:

  • Precision Finding available from up to 1.5x farther away
  • Up to 50% louder than the original
  • Hear AirTag 2 “from up to twice as far away”
  • A “suite of industry-first protections against unwanted tracking”

New AirTag 2 feature coming soon

The drop to $20/each for AirTag 2 comes ahead of iOS 27 and watchOS 27, which will be released next month. For Apple Watch users, there’s a nice upgrade: support for Precision Finding in the Find My app. This means you can now use your Apple Watch to locate an AirTag with on-screen arrows and specific information about how far away it is.

watchOS 27 also unifies the Find My experience into a single app. Previously, the Find My experience on Apple Watch consisted of three separate app icons on the app grid or list for people, items, and devices.

Meanwhile, iOS 27 upgrades the Find My app with a new design and interface changes to make it easier to track people and items.

With that in mind, now’s a great time to expand your AirTag 2 collection — especially at these prices.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)
